newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Emery sets up wholly-owned Korean unit.
newsitem.headline: Emery sets up wholly-owned Korean unit.

text.p: Seoul, April 21 (REUTER)- Emery Worldwide said it has formed a wholly-owned company, Emery Worldwide Korea Company Ltd, offering air and ocean freight services.
The new company's general manager is Lee Young Sup who has worked for 18 years in the Korean freight transportation industry.
Emery operates offices at Kimpo Airport and Kimhae Airport as well as in downtown Seoul and Pusan.

The company's vice president Asia Pacific, Cyril Rodrigo said: "Emery Worldwide has been operating in Korea for 12 years and in that period our business volume has grown dramatically, especially in the import/export markets in the automotive, chemical, electronic, fashion, healthcare and textile industries. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
